summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release confirming shipment of two BLISS systems to the U.S. Army Yuma Test Center for test and evaluation. No financial terms, stakeholder changes, or strategic actions are disclosed. This is a routine operational update about product delivery and does not constitute a special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a routine report on business progress with no special situation elements.
